title: Symposia Overview
summary: IEEE SSCI 2027 consists of 10 proposed symposia and multidisciplinary computational intelligence incubator special sessions.

paragraphs: IEEE SSCI 2027 consists of 10 Symposia, including the Multidisciplinary Computational Intelligence (CI) Incubators Symposia that provides special sessions in developing Applied CI domains.
